context: This week's 12 teams put up 1708.5 points between them, 142.38 a team.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Nobody stranded more points on the bench than Supernovas (81.08), headlined by Emanuel Wilson's 27.0-point no-show in the starting lineup.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Proof records can lie: Supernova Takeover beat ROK Navy's Finest despite the 9th-worst score of the week.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: Big Dumb Sports's defense (well, their opponent's offense) did the work: Chig-a-Doodle-Doo finished with just 100.58.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: Chig-a-Doodle-Doo lost by 67.2 to Big Dumb Sports this week -- the kind of score you screenshot and never bring up again.
